short_description: Mid-market CX platform evaluating Redwood for RAG-based ticket deflection: large embedding index, tight latency SLOs, reranking for top-5 quality.
notes:
Acct background: Cinderlane AssistWorks builds an omnichannel support platform used by retail & fintech SMBs. Strong LLM roadmap; hiring ML infra lead (Apr). Current stack: PostgreSQL for metadata, Vector DB PoC (on-premible), custom cross-encoder reranker prototype.

Timeline: 
- 2026-01-15: Intro discovery (Avery) — customer stated latency is make-or-break.
- 2026-02-10: Product demo (hosted API + demo index) — showed similarity search + simple rerank.
- 2026-02-25: Security questionnaire submitted; asked about KMS/HSM and audit logs.
- 2026-03-05: POC kickoff (dedicated config) — ingest ~2M historical tickets, 40M short text candidate docs expected at scale.
- 2026-03-10: Mid-POC sync — ran baseline embedding index on hosted test, 95th p99 query latency ~420ms (unacceptable).
- 2026-03-12: POC results delivered (micro-benchmarks) — Redwood dedicated + KV prefix caching reduced p95 to 180-220ms end-to-end for 5-shot agent flow; reranker (cross-encoder) improves top-5 precision to ~88% on evaluation set.

Technical requirements / notes: 
- Workload: RAG for live agent UI + pre-chat deflection (fast retrieval + cross-encoder rerank).
- Indexing scale: expect 20-50M vectors (short docs, avg 128 tokens). Freshness: nightly + ad-hoc indexing.
- Throughput target: 40-120 QPS during peak (support surge windows).
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 250ms end-to-end (embedding search + rerank + network) for agent UX; pre-chat deflect can be softer ~400ms. Customer line: "can't exceed 200ms for agent live REPLY" (product PM).
- Quality target: top-5 reranking precision >= 90% on in-house eval (they currently measure recall@5 + human QA). Current POC reached ~88% with open cross-encoder; want improvement or tradeoffs.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (all-in) < $0.03/query at median load; very sensitive to per-token generation cost. Interested in batching, quantization, and reranker distillation.
- Model preferences: prefer open/verified models for transparency; open to proprietary variants if SLA + cost align. Need fallback routing to cheaper model during capacity constraints.
- Routing/fallback: multi-tier policy required (primary: dedicated high-perf model; fallback: smaller quantized model; final: cached answer).
- Security: VPC endpoints, SAML SSO for team, audit logs retained 12+ months, KMS for key material, option for on-prem air-gapped evaluation if required by customers.

POC details & findings: 
- Embedded index (hosted test) used 3 shard config; memory pressure high for 20M vectors. Dedicated nodes with optimized kernels lowered per-query CPU overhead.
- KV prefix caching cut repeated token cost 20-30% for agent multi-turn sessions.
- Reranker: current cross-encoder gives quality lift but doubles latency if run on CPU; GPU colocated rerank stage with batching required to meet SLOs.
- Suggested Redwood leverages: continuous batching, automatic KV caching, model compilation tuned to sequence-length distribution, and smart routing to cheaper tier for deflection queries.

Customer quotes / signals: 
- PM: "We need predictable latency — surprises kill agent adoption."
- Engineering Dir: "If we can hit p95 ~200ms and QA shows top-5 is solid, we'll move to a reserved capacity contract."

Next steps (short): 
- Finalize dedicated cluster sizing + cost estimate (Mar 18) — action: SE (Marcos) to deliver two sizing options: conservative (redundant GPUs) and optimized (burst + autoscale).
- Security: schedule KMS deep-dive with Redwood security (Mar 20).
- Procurement: legal to review T&Cs, target contract sign in April (forecast 2026-04).

Open blockers: security KMS acceptance, demonstration of stable top-5 >=90% (may require reranker model tuning), internal procurement timing.

Linked artifacts: Fireflies ff_20260305 (POC kickoff), demo drive deck, security FAQ.
